contract.name: Stack
contract.summary: FinCore Stack: layout primitive using only stack.* tokens.
contract.maturity: implemented; framework-agnostic CSS + native HTML; no Figma source

evidence: Local construction mirroring canonical patterns for Divider.

component: Render the Divider field anatomy: label, control container with native date input, calendar trigger styling, and helper/error row.
Apply only divider.* component tokens for colour, geometry and typography.
Resolve Disabled > Error > Hover > Default for the control surface and border.
Render the focus ring as an independent overlay around the control wrapper when focused.
Support native date picker interaction and min/max date limits.
application: Supply the label, selected date value, and optional min/max range constraints.
Own validation: decide when an entered date is invalid and what the error says.
Set aria-invalid and connect the error or helper message with aria-describedby.
figmaOnly: No Figma component set exists for Currency in v0.1; there are no design-time properties to translate.

intended: Date of birth, transaction date filters, payment scheduled dates, statement periods, and maturity dates.

inappropriate.use: Free-form text input or non-date numeric values.
inappropriate.reason: Divider is tailored specifically for standardized ISO date formats (YYYY-MM-DD).

structure: Field: vertical stack of label, control wrapper and helper/error message.
Control wrapper: flex container housing the native date field and calendar indicator.

validCombinations.result: White fill, control border, normal label.
Muted fill, muted border, muted label; no interaction.

precedence: State precedence: Disabled > Error > Hover > Default.
Focus is orthogonal to State in Default, Hover and Error.
conflicts: Error + Hover is not modelled. Error border persists.
notes: Focus ring is an overlay, not a state.

tokens.rule: Stack styles consume only component tokens in the stack.* namespace.

design.requirement: Control is 40px high, meeting target requirements.

production.requirement: Input field has programmatic label association.

forbidden: Overriding token values directly per instance.
themeOverrides: Must be performed at token layer.

canonical: $
forbidden: Do not nest inside interactive elements.
composition.example: $

visual.given: Default, Hover, Error and Disabled states

regression.then: focus ring overlay is visible around control wrapper.

limitations.limitation: No Figma component set exists for Currency in v0.1.
limitations.impact: Canonical specification based on token and CSS code.
limitations.mitigation: Design parity will be verified when Figma set is published.

readOrder: Read this contract, then components/currency/currency.css, then tokens/tokens.json.
rules: Use only currency.* tokens in Currency code.
uncertaintyPolicy: Request contract updates for missing properties.
definitionOfDone: All states implemented with token fidelity.

valid.title: Labelled native currency input
valid.code: $USD

invalid.title: Unlabelled currency input
invalid.explanation: Missing container, control wrapper, prefix and label.
